_doc: REGISTRU DE RETETE. Cunoasterea lui Kelion despre ce unealta rezolva ce problema si cum se instaleaza DETERMINIST (Adrian, 12 iul: sa stie de ce are nevoie, sa-si instaleze dependintele constient). Fiecare intrare: detect (verific daca exista), install (cum il pun), verify (dovada ca merge). Niciun LLM nu interpreteaza aici. Kelion ALEGE numele, registrul EXECUTA fix. Reteta noua invatata se adauga aici.

docker.descriere: Motor de containere. Necesar pentru orice serviciu izolat (LiveKit, Caddy).
docker.install: apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y docker.io && systemctl enable --now docker

caddy.descriere: Reverse-proxy cu TLS automat (Let's Encrypt). Rezolva certificatul valid fara munca manuala.
caddy.detect: docker image inspect caddy:2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v caddy >/dev/null 2>&1
caddy.verify: docker image inspect caddy:2 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo caddy2-prezent

ffmpeg.descriere: Prelucrare audio/video (transcodare, extragere cadre, conversie formate).
ffmpeg.install: apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y ffmpeg

sshpass.descriere: Autentificare SSH cu parola in scripturi neinteractive.
sshpass.install: apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y sshpass

python3.install: apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip

tls-pentru-ip.descriere: PATTERN (rezolvat 12 iul): certificat TLS VALID pentru un server pe IP simplu, fara domeniu cumparat si fara a atinge DNS-ul. Folosim <a-b-c-d>.sslip.io (mapeaza direct IP-ul) plus Caddy auto-TLS. Reteta completa e in bridge/kelion-livekit-tls.mjs. Nu e un pachet, e o solutie de aplicat.
tls-pentru-ip.install: echo PATTERN-nu-pachet: vezi bridge/kelion-livekit-tls.mjs (hostname sslip.io + Caddy reverse-proxy --from HOST --to localhost:PORT)
tls-pentru-ip.verify: echo verifica-cu: curl -sS -o /dev/null -w %{http_code} https://HOST/ (fara -k = cert valid)

deschide-port.descriere: PATTERN: deschide un port in firewall (ufw) daca e activ. Necesar ex. pentru 80/443 (ACME) sau 7882/udp (WebRTC).
deschide-port.detect: command -v ufw >/dev/null 2>&1 && ufw status | grep -qi active
deschide-port.install: echo foloseste: ufw allow PORT/PROTO (ex ufw allow 443/tcp)
